http_ratelimit.expression: http.host eq "neurosis.io" and http.request.method eq "POST" and http.request.uri.path eq "/v1/engrams"

http_request_cache_settings.description: Observe requests and prevent stale anonymous memory

http_request_firewall_custom.description: NEUROSIS supports only its documented public methods
http_request_firewall_custom.expression: http.host eq "neurosis.io" and (not http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD" "POST" "OPTIONS"} or (http.request.method eq "POST" and http.request.uri.path ne "/v1/engrams"))

http_request_firewall_managed.description: Managed protection for documentation and retrieval
http_request_firewall_managed.expression: http.host eq "neurosis.io" and not (http.request.method eq "POST" and http.request.uri.path eq "/v1/engrams")
